sources.title: Batch 0047 source-first inventory for Zhang-surname maximum-score SQL

claims.text: The preserved source gives only student name, subject name and score columns plus the requirement to return Zhang-surname names and corresponding highest scores; table name, student identifier, ordering, NULL policy and homonym semantics are not preserved constraints and are explicitly separated from source facts.

The executable fixture verifies filtering names by the Zhang prefix, grouping by the declared name-level result grain and applying MAX(score), while excluding non-Zhang rows even when they have higher scores.
The fixture covers tied maximum values and an empty no-Zhang result; the answer separately documents the unrecoverable student-identity, NULL and ordering boundaries rather than inventing them.
